name: Antibiotic
text: Amoxicillin 500 mg: take 2 capsules twice a day after meals for 5 days. Do not drink alcohol while taking this medicine.

name: After knee surgery
text:
Paracetamol 500 mg: 1 tablet three times a day after food for 7 days.
Ibuprofen 400 mg: 1 tablet in the morning and at night with food for 5 days. Do not drive.
Knee bends: lying on your back, bend the knee to 90 degrees, 10 times, 3 sets, twice a day.
Straight leg raise: lift the leg to 45 degrees, 10 times, 2 sets, twice a day.
Come back to the hospital if you have fever, swelling in the leg, or fluid from the wound.
Follow-up appointment on 2026-10-26 at the orthopaedic clinic.

name: Heart medicines
text:
Atorvastatin 20 mg: 1 tablet at bedtime.
Aspirin 75 mg: 1 tablet every morning after breakfast.
Return immediately if you have chest pain, bleeding or dizziness.

name: After eye surgery
text:
Moxifloxacin eye drops: 1 drop four times a day for 7 days. Do not drive.
Paracetamol 500 mg: 1 tablet at night after food for 3 days. Do not lift heavy things.
Come back to the hospital if you have strong pain, vomiting or a rash.
Follow-up appointment on 2026-10-19 at the eye clinic.
